newsitem.title: USA: Unfunded mandates report given to Ohio governor.
newsitem.headline: Unfunded mandates report given to Ohio governor.

text.p: A report recommending ways to ease the burden of unfunded mandates on locals governments and school districts was presented Tuesday to Ohio Gov. George Voinovich.

The report by the State and Local Government Commission of Ohio and its Local Government Mandate Task Force listed among recommendations a $6 million line-item set-aside in the upcoming state biennial budget for unfunded mandate assistance.
Other proposals included a sunset provision for future mandates and an annual review and reduction of administrative mandates.
A spokeswoman for Voinovich said the governor would reivew the report.
